name: Mentorship Outreach
description: Writes a personalized mentorship request message that is specific, time-respectful, and contains a clear ask. Produces a ready-to-send outreach message. Use when the user wants to reach out to a potential mentor, ask someone for career guidance, or write a message requesting an informational conversation or ongoing mentorship relationship. Do NOT use for cold outreach for job opportunities (use cold-outreach-email), networking event follow-ups (use networking-message-writer), or recruiter messages (use recruiter-outreach).
